segments.ja510:1.3: Abbhuṭṭhitova so yāti [sayati (sī. pī.), sa yāti (katthaci)], sagacchaṃ na nivattati.
segments.ja510:2.1: Na yujjhamānā na balenavassitā, narā na jīranti na cāpi miyyare;
segments.ja510:2.3: Sabbaṃ hidaṃ [hi taṃ (sī. pī.)] jātijarāyupaddutaṃ, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:3.1: Caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ subhiṃsarūpaṃ, jayanti raṭṭhādhipatī pasayha;
segments.ja510:3.3: Na maccuno jayitumussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:4.1: Hatthīhi assehi rathehi pattibhi, parivāritā muccare ekacceyyā [ekaceyyā (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja510:4.3: Na maccuno [na maccuto (sī.)] muccitumussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:5.1: Hatthīhi assehi rathehi pattibhi, sūrā [purā (ka.)] pabhañjanti padhaṃsayanti;
segments.ja510:5.3: Na maccuno bhañjitumussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:6.1: Mattā gajā bhinnagaḷā [pabhinnagalā (sī.)] pabhinnā, nagarāni maddanti janaṃ hananti;
segments.ja510:6.3: Na maccuno madditumussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:7.1: Issāsino katahatthāpi vīrā [vīrā (sī. pī.)], dūrepātī [patī (ka.)] akkhaṇavedhinopi;
segments.ja510:7.3: Na maccuno vijjhitumussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:8.1: Sarāni khīyanti saselakānanā, sabbaṃ hidaṃ [hi taṃ (sī. pī.), pitaṃ (syā.)] khīyati dīghamantaraṃ;
segments.ja510:8.3: Sabbaṃ hidaṃ [hi taṃ (sī. pī.), pitaṃ (syā.)] bhañjare kālapariyāyaṃ, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:9.1: Sabbe samevaṃ hi narānanārinaṃ [narānarīnaṃ (pī.), nārī narānaṃ (syā.), naranārīnaṃ (ka.)], calācalaṃ pāṇabhunodha jīvitaṃ;
segments.ja510:9.3: Paṭova dhuttassa dumova kūlajo, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:10.1: Dumapphalāneva patanti māṇavā, daharā ca vuddhā ca sarīrabhedā;
segments.ja510:10.3: Nāriyo narā majjhimaporisā ca, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:11.1: Nāyaṃ vayo tārakarājasannibho, yadabbhatītaṃ gatameva dāni taṃ;
segments.ja510:11.3: Jiṇṇassa hī natthi ratī kuto sukhaṃ, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:12.1: Yakkhā pisācā athavāpi petā, kupitāte [kupitāpi te (sī. pī.)] assasanti manusse;
segments.ja510:12.3: Na maccuno assasitussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:13.1: Yakkhe pisāce athavāpi pete, kupitepi te nijjhapanaṃ karonti;
segments.ja510:13.3: Na maccuno nijjhapanaṃ karonti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:14.1: Aparādhake dūsake heṭhake ca, rājāno daṇḍenti viditvāna dosaṃ;
segments.ja510:14.3: Na maccuno daṇḍayitussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:15.1: Aparādhakā dūsakā heṭṭhakā ca, labhanti te rājino nijjhapetuṃ;
segments.ja510:15.3: Na maccuno nijjhapanaṃ karonti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:16.1: Na khattiyoti na ca brāhmaṇoti, na aḍḍhakā balavā tejavāpi;
segments.ja510:16.3: Na maccurājassa apekkhamatthi, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:17.1: Sīhā ca byagghā ca athopi dīpiyo, pasayha khādanti vipphandamānaṃ;
segments.ja510:17.3: Na maccuno khāditumussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:18.1: Māyākārā raṅgamajjhe karontā, mohenti cakkhūni janassa tāvade;
segments.ja510:18.3: Na maccuno mohayitussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:19.1: Āsīvisā kupitā uggatejā, ḍaṃsanti mārentipi te manusse;
segments.ja510:19.3: Na maccuno ḍaṃsitumussahanti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:20.1: Āsīvisā kupitā yaṃ ḍaṃsanti, tikicchakā tesa visaṃ hananti;
segments.ja510:20.3: Na maccuno daṭṭhavisaṃ [daṭṭhassa visaṃ (ka.)] hananti, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:21.1: Dhammantarī vettaraṇī [vetaraṇī (sī. pī.)] ca bhojo, visāni hantvāna bhujaṅgamānaṃ;
segments.ja510:21.3: Suyyanti te kālakatā tatheva, taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:22.3: Na maccurājassa vajantadassanaṃ [vajanti adassanaṃ (syā. ka.)], taṃ me matī hoti carāmi dhammaṃ.
segments.ja510:23.1: Dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukhamāvahāti;
segments.ja510:23.3: Esānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe, na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī.
segments.ja510:24.1: Na hi dhammo adhammo ca, ubho samavipākino;
segments.ja510:24.3: Adhammo nirayaṃ neti, dhammo pāpeti suggatinti.
segments.ja510:28.1: Mātaṅga sambhūta sivi sirimanto, rohaṇa haṃsa sattigumbo bhallātiya;
segments.ja510:28.3: Somanassa campeyya brahma pañca-paṇḍita cirassaṃvata ayogharāti. Vīsatinipātaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

lines: Tārakarājasannibhoti yathā tārakarājā kāḷapakkhe khīṇo, puna juṇhapakkhe pūrati, na evaṃ sattānaṃ vayo.
Sattānañhi yaṃ abbhatītaṃ, gatameva dāni taṃ, na tassa punāgamanaṃ atthi.
Kuto sukhanti jarājiṇṇassa kāmaguṇesu ratipi natthi, te paṭicca uppajjanakasukhaṃ kutoyeva.
Na maccunoti maccuṃ pana tepi assāsena upahanituṃ vā āvisituṃ vā na sakkonti.
Viditvāna dosanti dosaṃ jānitvā yathānurūpena daṇḍena daṇḍentīti attho.
Na maccunoti tepi maccuṃ daṇḍayituṃ na sakkonti.

Na aḍḍhakā balavā tejavāpīti “ime aḍḍhā, ayaṃ kāyabalañāṇabalādīhi balavā, ayaṃ tejavā”ti evampi na paccurājassa apekkhaṃ atthi, ekasmimpi satte apekkhaṃ pemaṃ sineho natthi, sabbameva abhimaddatīti dasseti.
Na maccunoti tepi maccuṃ khādituṃ na sakkonti.
Dhammantarī vettaraṇī ca bhojoti ete evaṃnāmakā vejjā.
Osadhehīti ghoraṃ vā gandhāriṃ vā vijjaṃ sāvetvā osadhaṃ ādāya tehi osadhehi paccatthikānaṃ adassanaṃ vajanti.
